question: Which of the following awards was conferred upon the Chhau dancer Siba Prasad Das in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Siba Prasad Das is a renowned Chhau dancer known for his contributions to the traditional dance form.
 
• In 2022, he was conferred with the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award is given to artists who have significantly contributed to the field of performing arts in India.
 
• The award is part of the initiative by Sangeet Natak Akademi to recognize and honor the talent and dedication of artists in various performing arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**

 
 
• It is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• Founded in 1952, it aims to promote and preserve India's vast cultural heritage of performing arts.
 
• The Akademi awards are considered the highest national recognition given to practicing artists.
 
 
 
• **Chhau Dance**
 
 
• Chhau is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk traditions.
 
• It is predominantly performed in the Indian states of Odisha, West Bengal, and Jharkhand.
 
• The dance is recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri**
 
 
• It is one of the highest civilian awards in India, awarded for distinguished service in various fields.
 
• The award was instituted in 1954 and is given annually on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship**
 
 
• This is a prestigious fellowship awarded by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to individuals for their lifetime achievement in the field of performing arts.
 
• It is different from the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, which is for significant contributions in a specific period.
